threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You can spot the newbies by their confusion during the tube strike; they’re the ones asking if the 38 bus still runs all night.
Caught a night bus home from Brixton, and a guy was arguing with a mannequin he thought was his mate. Only in South London, right?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I found a stray cat lounging in a Berlin U-Bahn seat, completely unfazed by the crowded train. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You ever notice how Kreuzberg has more Spätis open all night than anywhere else? It's like a life support system for night owls.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by how they know which BART station to avoid when there's smoke—Civic Center's closed, but they're still catching a ride elsewhere.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy singing opera on the 47 while a woman in a business suit filmed him. He ended with a bow, and we all applauded. Just another day on Muni.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia is all about the Gaudí houses, but go down Carrer de Juan Ramón Jiménez for authentic local cafés. It's a different vibe.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by their struggle with the metro ticket machines; they still hit the screen like it’s a slot machine.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it the ‘Overground’ instead of the ‘Ginger line’—bless your heart, you’ll learn soon enough.
Last night on the 77, a lad serenaded the whole bus with a harmonica. Weirdly, it made the 3 AM stop at Brixton feel like a gig.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a toddler riding a tiny bike past the kebab stand, while an old man argued with a pigeon over a bread roll. Classic Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg will you find a busker playing saxophone at dawn by the canal, while joggers dodge their way past half-sleeping ducks.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local when they know the taco truck schedules better than bus times. It's an art form, really.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 14 Mission rolling past a street mural that has more layers than some city politics. Only in SF do art and transit collide like that.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think every barra-cervesera is like in the guidebooks, but the real gems are the ones where the locals actually know your name.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them by their bewildered expressions when they realize how many different ways there are to order a coffee.
